ITEM STAYS OPEN: it is the gate continuously-tracked acceptance counter and self-closes on the first engaged published post. The tags are appended to a local variable at send time (packs/scheduling/lib/tasks/scheduled_posting.rake: published_caption = post.caption + Array(post.hashtags).join(' ')) and never persisted, so scheduling_posts.caption does NOT contain them and the local DB cannot tell a tagged send from an untagged one -- the same blind spot under which all 197 posted items shipped with zero tags for the account's whole life. FIX (this commit): new probe check check_published_hashtags_shipped + pure hashtag_shipped_verdict reads the PUBLISHED CAPTION BACK FROM INSTAGRAM (media node field caption) and counts the column's tags inside it; an unreadable media is UNKNOWN (never a failure) and only a caption containing NONE of a non-empty column's tags fires. VERIFIED with ground truth, not bookkeeping: readback on posts 331/323/339/330 -> column_tags=10 shipped_tags=10 for each (the caption tail carries all ten, e.g. '#lifestyleblogger ... #tinyjoys'). 2026-09-24 10:4xZ ops-triage: THE PIVOT'S OWN EVIDENCE WAS UNWATCHED -- now guarded, and verified against real data. The whole discovery pivot ('non-follower reach is a measured zero, so no content lever can move followers') rests on growth_snapshots.non_follower_reach, and that path is BEST-EFFORT BY DESIGN: MetricsCollector swallows a failed insights call, logs one warning and stores NULL, so the measurement can stop running with no error anywhere. check_insights_stale does NOT cover it (posts.insights_updated_at is a different endpoint and producer), latest_discovery_attribution() returns the newest NON-NULL row with NO age bound -- so this item's own evidence text would keep asserting non-follower=0 from a row that no longer describes the present -- and the client's own note says a breakdown that never reconciles with the account total 'is how a silently broken breakdown would show itself', yet no check compared the parts to the whole. FIXED in the repo: new check_discovery_attribution + pure attribution_verdict, firing on (a) newest attribution older than 6h (snapshots are hourly), (b) reach answered WITHOUT a follow_type breakdown = unmeasured, never zero, (c) follower+non-follower != reach_total. Staleness is judged FIRST so an old row cannot be reported as live. VERIFIED: selftest 646/0 (was 636; 10 new cases incl. never-measured-is-not-a-defect, right-at-bound, stale-beats-content); checks-audit 57 checks 0 raised 0 unreadable (was 56); and the check is not vacuous -- the live row (nf|fl|total = 0|5|5) reads quiet while the SAME row aged 7h returns warn and fl+1 returns the non-reconcile warn. DECISION, unchanged and now guarded: the arm stays SEQUENCED after the 2026-10-05 13:00Z read (the only missing piece is the rail wiring; a reel publishes with no photo, so it stays out of GateRead#cohort_size by construction), its success metric is non_follower_reach>0 -- the exact number this check now proves is still being taken -- and no levers, renders, GPU claims or posts were touched by this pass. Item stays open as the gate's continuously-tracked acceptance counter; self-closes on the first engaged published post.
